description: This file defines the 'Page' class for a web automation library, including methods for navigation, interaction, event handling, and request routing, as well as related classes and type definitions.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a web page with methods for navigation, interaction, event handling, and request routing within a browser context.

classes.name: BindingCall
classes.description: Handles invocation of bindings from the page context, allowing external functions to be called from page scripts.
